scope: Static browser regression ceilings for the locally served candidate. These are engineering guardrails, not claims about physical-device performance.
policy: Budgets are intentionally generous ceilings for regression detection and should trend downward as legacy runtime layers are retired.
A passing automated budget does not substitute for physical iOS/iPadOS/Android startup, offline, update, storage-pressure or assistive-technology evidence.
Tighten a ceiling only after measuring representative CI and physical-device distributions; do not loosen a ceiling merely to make a regression pass.
